title: Mapa Mental de Negocios Dibujado a Mano: Hoja de Ruta de Progreso en Tres Etapas
prompt:
A high-quality hand-drawn business mind map, Sketch-note style, white paper background.

Image structure:

Three horizontally arranged stage progression cards.

Left card (Stage 1): Orange main color, rocket icon at top, contains text list.

Middle card (Stage 2): Cyan/teal main color, stacked boxes/asset icon at top, contains text list.

Right card (Stage 3): Deep blue main color, mountain with flag icon at top, contains text list.

Decorative elements: Background has a diagonal arrow line growing from bottom-left to top-right, dotted with stars, dashed lines, checkmarks and other doodle elements. Bottom has a yellow banner with call-to-action text.

Artistic style: Marker hand-drawn texture, smooth lines, vibrant colors (orange, cyan, blue, yellow), flat illustration, clear visuals, business education style.

Topic: Product yourself
